title: North Davis Gymnastics

services.name: Compulsory Gymnastics
services.desc: North Davis Gymnastics has an extensive girls competitive program. Our goal is to strive to pull the most out of every girl that has ambitions to compete and to improve their gymnastics skill

services.name: Birthday Parties
services.desc: Gymnastics Birthday Parties are an excellent way to celebrate that special day for your child and will leave lasting memories for all involved. Available for children age 5-12, the birthday parties include approximately 60 min of age appropriate gymnastics instruction and team games. The last 30 min are utilized for refreshments and gifts (Food is not provided by North Davis Gymnastics). Parents are responsible for all food, plates, cups, napkins, etc. You will have 15 min to set up and 15 min to tear back down. Birthday parties are scheduled based on staff availabilities.
